name_en: Relief Assistance to Marine Fishermen families during Fishing Ban period
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your marine fishing family gets Rs 8,000 as relief during the fishing ban. The ban is 61 days every year, when fish breed. On the East Coast it is April 15 to June 14. On the West Coast it is June 1 to July 31.

other: You must have a valid family ration card or smart card.
If you or your family members have a regular job or other income, you cannot get this.
You must be a member of a Fishermen Co-operative Society.
If you work on a mechanised boat, you need a work certificate from the boat owner.

documents: Bank passbook first page copy (with photo)
Work certificate from the boat owner
Copy of enrolment through the e-Sevai centre
how_to_apply: Fill the application form. Attach your papers. You need to enrol through an e-Sevai centre.
